content: HF Spaces native OAuth: add hf_oauth: true to README YAML metadata; HF injects OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, OAUTH_SCOPES, OPENID_PROVIDER_URL, SPACE_HOST as flat env vars -- no external IdP registration needed. Spaces pages embed the app in a cross-origin iframe (huggingface.co -> *.hf.space), and HF's own docs warn cookie-based flows should use target=_blank on the login button or be accessed outside the iframe, since browsers restrict cross-site iframe cookies.
